Fly Zermatt offers tandem flights around Zermatt, with several flight profiles depending on the take-off and the season.
Paragliding Interlaken offers tandem flights above Interlaken, with passenger conditions and options described on its website.
Skywings offers tandem flights in Interlaken in summer and winter, with an extended-flight option in summer and a photo and video service.
Zurich Paragliding offers tandem flights from several sites reachable from Zurich. The location depends on the package and the conditions.
Chabl'évasion offers tandem flights in the Villars-sur-Ollon area. The tourist office describes the flight variants and the meeting points.
The operator offers tandem flights in the Grindelwald area. Check the packages and their availability on the organiser's booking path.
Paragliding Luzern offers tandem flights around Lucerne and Mount Pilatus. The website describes flight times, access to the take-offs and gift vouchers.
Lazulibre offers introductory courses and paragliding training from the Lausanne area. The school publishes its prices and the conditions of the course.
Ikarus is a name to be checked in the survey of Flemish providers. Confirm directly which activities can be booked and where they take place.
Air-Davos offers tandem flights above Davos and Klosters. The catalogue gives the packages, flight time, gift vouchers and meeting-point options.
FlyTicino organises tandem flights in Ticino, notably around Lugano and Locarno. The website details the flight variants, passenger conditions and image options.

Airsport offers progression on the training slope and high-flight courses in the mountains. Its bilingual website publishes the levels, prices, course dates and booking status. The actual training location is given for each session.

Leysin Parapente is Stéphane Bigler's school. Its page presents introductory, training and improvement activities, as well as tandem and hike-and-fly flights. The school publishes a phone number and an email address for information and bookings.

The ParAdventure Centre is listed as a paragliding school in Les Diablerets by the Swiss Free Flight Federation. The tourist office notably presents its paragliding flights at Glacier 3000. Check the packages, participation conditions and booking arrangements with the centre.

Aéroloisirs is a paragliding and hang-gliding club or school in Liège, approved by the Belgian Free Flight Federation (FBVL). Its manager is Olivier Georis. The federation's listing gives neither the packages, nor the flying sites, nor the prices: for a course or a first flight, contact the club directly by phone or email.

PanPam Airlines offers paragliding tandem flights in Leysin with Marc-Éric Pantillon. After the briefing, take-off is from La Berneuse, reached by gondola. The flight passes over the village and ends near the lift station. HD images are available as an option on a USB stick. The team also welcomes groups on request.

Zinal Grimentz Parapente offers tandem flights above Zinal or Grimentz, in the Val d'Anniviers, taking off from the Weisshorn area. The team also presents a course to learn to fly. Its website does not yet show a price: ask the school for prices, durations and time slots by email or through its form.

Christophe Smith is a free-flight instructor in Villars-sur-Ollon. The Villars Swiss Ski School lists his school as a provider of paragliding tandem flights. Take-off is from the Roc d'Orsay if conditions allow. The flight lasts about 15 to 20 minutes and the package may include photos. The meeting point is set with the school when you book.

X1X is a paragliding club or school in Marche-en-Famenne, in the province of Luxembourg, listed by the Belgian Free Flight Federation (FBVL). Its manager is Vincent Gillard. The club has no website, only social-media pages, and the federation's listing gives neither the packages, nor the flying sites, nor the prices: contact it by email.

Thalia Parapente supports students in Leysin, notably at La Berneuse, from the first high solo flight to preparation for the Swiss licence. Students can continue with the Progression Pack or flying and theory sessions. The brand also lists tandem flights in Charmey, in the Gruyère region, organised by Marco Guarino, taking off from the Vounetz area depending on conditions.

Bol d'Air offers paragliding tandem flights in Les Diablerets, from the 10 to 15-minute discovery flight to longer flights from Glacier 3000. The school also organises flights in an adapted seat, outings that combine hiking and flying, and training leading to the Swiss licence. Pilots who already hold a licence can try cross-country flying on a course in the Ormonts valley.

Villars-Gryon'Air offers tandem flights above Villars and Ollon as well as training in the Vaud Alps. The educational tandem lets you try the dual controls with an instructor. The school offers a discovery day, a two-day introduction, a course up to the Swiss free-flight licence and refresher sessions. It also sells and hires equipment.

Sam-Air organises paragliding tandem flights in Verbier, generally taking off from Les Ruinettes and landing at Le Châble. The team offers a discovery package, a package with images and experiences that combine flying with mountain activities. Independent pilots can also join outings or courses, notably weekends combining ski touring and paragliding in the Valais.

Julien Suchet is the contact given by the Leysin Swiss Ski School for discovery tandem flights. The page distinguishes two packages depending on the landing field, in Leysin or in Aigle. Photos and videos can be added as an option. The flight offers a view of the Ormonts, the Diablerets and the Rhône valley. The exact meeting point is to be agreed when booking.

Paragliding Performance School is a paragliding school in Marilles, in Walloon Brabant, run by Olivier Gillot and listed by the Belgian Free Flight Federation (FBVL). Its name makes clear that it is not for beginners: it is aimed at pilots who want to progress. The federation's listing gives neither the packages, nor the flying sites, nor the prices: contact the school before signing up.

Airpassion is a paragliding school in Montbovon, in the Gruyère region, run by Simon Brunetti. It offers three tandem flights: Powerplay (130 CHF, about 10 minutes), Gotteron (160 CHF, 10 to 20 minutes, often late in the afternoon depending on the weather) and Sprunger (190 CHF, 20 to 30 minutes). Booking is online. The website also has a page to discover paragliding and tandem licence training.

Verbier Summits organises tandem flights above the resort and paragliding courses led by Mike and Stu. Beginners can start with an introductory day or follow a two-stage course. The school also offers courses in thermals, cross-country and aerobatics. Tandem flights take off from Les Ruinettes depending on the weather. Several courses can be booked with accommodation in Le Châble.

Val d'Illiair Parapente offers tandem flights from the summits above Champéry and Val-d'Illiez, every day of the year, from 8 am to 5 pm, depending on bookings and the weather. Two flights are offered, photos and videos included: the Big Flight (190 CHF) and the Prestige flight (230 CHF). Booking is online and payment by card, cash, Apple Pay or Twint. The Illiez Card gives a 15% discount.

Fly Away is a paragliding school in Val-d'Illiez, in the Swiss Portes du Soleil. It offers an introductory day, equipment included (160 CHF), and tandem flights from 100 to 180 CHF depending on altitude, taking off from Champoussin, Les Crosets or Champéry. Booking is compulsory; payment is by cash or Twint. The Illiez Card gives a 20% discount on the long tandem flight and the introductory day.

Paradelta, based in Troinex near Geneva, is a paragliding school that offers tandem flights from the summit of the Salève: Bi-Cool, Discovery and Sensation, and the Premium flight (240 CHF, 25 to 35 minutes, photos and video at 35 CHF). You meet at the Troinex landing field and a minibus takes you to the summit. Booking is by form or phone, with no deposit. The activity is closed from 29 October to 1 March.

Based in Limal, near Wavre, Imala Parapente guides students from their first sessions on the training slope to high flights. The school also offers courses in improvement, thermal flying, cross-country and mountain pilot handling. Training-slope days take place in Belgium and the destinations of the mountain courses are given in the calendar. Imala also has a workshop for checking and repairing wings.

The Philippe Briod Free Flight School has taught paragliding and hang gliding for over 35 years, with the aim of making students independent. It is based at the Suchet, in the canton of Vaud, from April to December, then in Zinal during the ski season. Its website presents introductory sessions of one or more days, theory and practical training, tandem flights, speed flying and winch launching. Ask the school for prices.

Yoofly, run by Olivier and Valentin in Enney, offers tandem flights in the Gruyère region taking off from Grandvillard, Charmey, Gstaad, Rougemont or, in winter, the Moléson. The packages are named after coffees: Ristretto (150 CHF, 5 to 10 minutes), Espresso (190 CHF, 20 minutes), Lungo (240 CHF, 40 minutes), Capuccino (290 CHF, 60 minutes) and Early Bird at sunrise (320 CHF). Maximum weight is 95 kg. Online booking; gift vouchers available.

Gruyère Parapente, founded by Marc and Amandine Pugin in Épagny, is a paragliding school that also offers tandem flights in the Gruyère region: Trick for a first flight (130 CHF, about 10 minutes), Thermal (190 CHF, about 25 minutes), Aerobatic (250 CHF) and mountain flights preceded by a walk, from 250 CHF depending on the summit. A group rate applies from five people. Booking online or by phone; gift vouchers available.

Les Ailes du Léman fly from Sonchaux, above Villeneuve, with a meeting point at the Noville landing field. Tandem flights last about 15 minutes: Discovery and Sensation (190 CHF), Little Prince for ages 6 to 16 (150 CHF), student rate (150 CHF) and couples' flight (340 CHF). The school also teaches paragliding: introductory course (900 CHF), complete training (2,600 CHF) and discovery days at 350 CHF. Booking online or by phone.

Riviera Parapente offers a panoramic tandem flight above the Vaud Riviera. You go up to Les Pléiades (about 1,310 m) on the Vevey-Blonay–Les Pléiades rack railway, then fly for about 15 to 20 minutes depending on the weather, landing at Blonay or Chailly. The flight costs from 180 CHF, photos and videos extra. You need to arrive 15 minutes early, and booking is online from the offer page on the Switzerland Tourism website.

Paragliding Gruyère, run by Pierre-Alain Hayoz, offers tandem flights in the Gruyère region from Gruyères. The “Icarus's Dream” flight (120 CHF, about 10 minutes) is open all year from age 6; the high flight (190 CHF, about 25 minutes) and the aerobatic Premium flight (220 CHF) are offered from April to September, and a child flight for ages 6 to 12 costs 100 CHF. Take-off is at Charmey, the Moléson or Grandvillard. Booking online, by email or by phone.

ACBFLY Dents du Midi, pilot Basile Marclay, offers tandem flights with a qualified instructor in the Dents du Midi region, at Val-d'Illiez and Champéry. Three packages are listed: Discovery (120 CHF) for a mountain panorama, Classic (140 CHF) to enjoy the thermals, and Prestige (180 CHF) for a long flight over the whole region. A gift voucher is available. Basile Marclay also presents his flights under the name Champéry Parapente, with a flight at 160 CHF.

Fly Riviera is a paragliding school in Villeneuve, on the Vaud Riviera. It trains for the licence, gives introductory and theory courses, and offers tandem flights from Sonchaux, with photos and videos: 230 CHF for an adult, 210 CHF for a student and 190 CHF for a child. The meeting point is on the chemin du Pré des Fourches, in Noville. Under-14s need parental permission; 20% discount with the Lausanne City Pass. Booking on the website.

Flyin'high offers tandem flights in Crans-Montana, every day of the year by appointment. Three flights are offered, for ages 5 to 95 and 20 to 100 kg: Discovery (180 CHF, about 15 minutes), High flight (210 CHF, 20 to 25 minutes, April to November) and Magic flight (280 CHF, 30 to 35 minutes). Depending on the season, take-off is from Bella Lui, Cry d'Err, Petit Bonvin, Aminona or Aprily; lifts are not included. Booking by form or by phone.

Flyverbier is a paragliding school in Verbier, in the Val de Bagnes, about 30 minutes from Martigny. It offers tandem flights all year depending on the weather, of 15 to 30 minutes, with pilots certified by the Swiss Free Flight Federation, and flights adapted for people with reduced mobility on request. The introductory course costs 910 CHF, from age 14, with an orientation tandem flight followed by five first solo flights. Booking by phone, email or on the website.

Parapente Confluence is a paragliding school in Buzet, in Hainaut, approved by the Belgian Free Flight Federation, with instructors and assistant federal instructors. It offers the training slope for beginners, first high flights and progression, improvement courses, SIV (simulated flight incidents) and a performance course in Ölüdeniz. A Discovery voucher lets you give an introductory day as a gift. The calendar can be downloaded from the website; book by phone from 11 am or by email.

Fou d'L is a paragliding school in Godinne, in the province of Namur, which says it is one of the only schools approved for all its activities by the Belgian Free Flight Federation. The training slope is open all year by appointment, and guided high-flight courses from 200 to 1,200 m are organised every month. The catalogue also includes progression, cross-country, pilot handling, hike-and-fly, speed riding, a course at the Dune du Pilat and tandem training. Contact by email or phone, no texts.
